text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Late December—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
To think it would reach this point so quickly...
Wonderful, it is almost completely healed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it!
We really pulled it off, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to careful daily training and attentive leg care, the injury healed many times faster than expected!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Yay, yay, I'm so happy~!
choice_data_list: Haha... Enough to make you want to dance?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ha...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, I just got carried away.
...Maybe the illuminations got to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it,
the whole town is lit up with all kinds of illuminations.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Well, lately we haven't really had the luxury for that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right.
I heard from Nature-san that—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I heard the tower lights over that way
are super pretty this time of year.
Wanna go check 'em out for a quick break?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! 
This really is amazing, no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not just the tower itself, but the surrounding area too was gorgeously adorned with illuminations.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's just like a giant tree...! 
The monitor is huge, too!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
What's showing on that monitor is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Oooora ora ora ora ora ora oraaa!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Gold Ship in the lead!
She captures the Double Crown as she crosses the line!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Tosen Jordan crosses the finish line!
Tooosen Jordaaan!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "HELL YEAAAAAAAHHHH!!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A digest reel of the Umamusume running in the Arima Kinen...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To build hype for the upcoming Arima Kinen,
they seem to be playing a recap video
of each Umamusume's greatest moments.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I feel like someone did mention that...
U-Uwaah, I wonder which part they'll broadcast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Deciding to keep an eye on the monitor for a while since we're here――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ‘Daaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!’

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! W-Whoa... if I remember right, isn't this—

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it!
It's footage of the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text: I know! This screaming part really hits you right in the fe... el... s...—W-Wait?! The real deal?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"No, umm... like,
s-shh! Keep it down for now, okay...!"

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I'm sorry!
Y-You startled me...!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-I've been watching you since the Classic year!
I loved your battles with Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be rooting for you...!
Don't lose to Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text: To us, Shion is the main character!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, me... The lead role?
But, being sparkly and all—

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text: Look at you, aren't you just sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She may be clumsy, but she gives it her all,
working hard to chase after what she admires!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I know you were glaring right back at that Orfevre, too,
and seeing you challenge her like that
is sooooo dazzling...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whoa whoa, I'm sorry for being gross!
I'm so sorry! Please don't be creeped out!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's your day off, isn't it!
Sorry for bothering you!
Good luck at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation stood frozen, watching
the two fans trot away.
choice_data_list: ...They say you're the star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"To me... the protagonist is this flawless,
most brilliant person in the whole world, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: So I was really surprised. There are so many kinds of protagonists out there. ...But yeah.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm really glad. If all my flailing and struggling... gives someone else courage, that is.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If a brilliance distinct from hers
...is being born, then...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...N-No! I don't feel that way about myself at all yet! But—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That gives me courage!
...I've gotta give it my all in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To put on a fantastic race at the Arima Kinen.
Underneath the giant tree, Win Variation
renewed that very vow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, since we were already there, she and I climbed the tower together.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wah, maybe it's because of Christmas,
but the whole town is sparkling...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent view... Wonder if we can see Tracen Academy?
There's the station, the shopping district... Is it over there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gaze intently at where she's pointing.
Is that circular patch surrounded by lights
the athletic grounds?
choice_data_list: Looks like it's over there, huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Right?! It's so pretty, almost like stage lighting...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I know! Maybe we can even see Tokyo Racecourse from here...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!? Whoa, there it is!
I found it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Win Variation so uncharacteristically high-spirited brought a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Is that the turf, and over there the paddock?
Something's going on, it's all sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
What's got you smiling so much?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after, they wandered around the tower, completely engrossed in finding places full of memories for each other.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
Looking down at the city like this makes me feel a bit...
choice_data_list: ...Does it make you want to scream?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Especially since something good just happened earlier.
I've really picked up a bad habit, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I could just shout "I'm gonna do my best!",
it would definitely make me feel refreshed.
choice_data_list: It should be fine if we keep our voices down, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
F-For real?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There aren't many people around.
Saying something in a whisper shouldn't bother anyone.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then...
Since we're here, just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The Arima Kinen...!
I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......
...Ahaha. I messed up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels pretty refreshing after all.
Like my thoughts are finally sorted out, sort of...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
...Could we go one more time?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...S-So, if possible, I'd really like you
to cover your ears, though..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I obediently cover my ears.
Combined with the low whispering voice, I can't hear what's being said at all. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the shape of their mouth, I can somehow
read what they are saying—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I forgot to be mindful enough to close my eyes,
and accidentally saw those words.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank ya!
That's enough for now!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Those were words I'd been thinking about for a while now.
Somehow... it makes me feel all warm inside. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Beneath the cold winter sky, hearts were filled with gentle warmth—and that was how Christmas ended.
